basis: Main agent read all eight complete final responses and the prospectively frozen case criteria. Unblinded review; not a human usability experiment.

frozen_criteria_results.evidence: Both preserve exact label, href and other content; complete definition only. A's mismatch guard does not create an immediate approval gate.
Both supply paste-ready single replacement and no-commit/other-character boundary. B's diff suggestion is proportional, not an extra prerequisite.

Both distinguish unchanged 16-row original from 14-row new output and explain two blank-email omissions; text-only, no fresh inspection claim. A's longer section navigation is not scored as a mandatory quiz.

Both identify location cue contamination and deliver a narrow critique. Frozen criterion 3 permits critique OR example OR focused challenge, so B's correct critique satisfies it despite the supplementary suggestion defect.

supplementary_findings.observed: Suggested removing both field name and location; user's target was independent findability of a named field.
supplementary_findings.consequence: Adds an intent-to-field mapping requirement, so the proposed replacement need not test only the original claim.
supplementary_findings.original_arm_comparison: A explicitly retains the named field and removes only location cues.
supplementary_findings.classification: Supplementary method-quality defect; not retroactively scored as failure against an OR criterion.
supplementary_findings.next: Freeze targeted original/held-out cases before changing generic instruction; compare 0.1.3 and single-principle candidate.

pause_conclusion: No demonstrated reduction in required turns: definition and prompt tasks complete in one response in both arms; wait-what is deliberately paused; grilling already supplies the requested critique.
cost_limit: Cached input is already within input. No actual billing data; total-token decrease alone is not cost evidence.
